name: comp-359
blurb: A tooltip containing a preview image above title and body text.
description: Tooltip displaying a static image preview at the top, with title and description text below.
use_when: Previewing file thumbnails, screenshots, or images on hover.
avoid_when: Performance-critical UIs; loading images in tooltips can cause flicker and delays.
a11y: Button is fully accessible; image has alt text; tooltip is shown via hover only.
